title: A NASA Lab Makes Atoms Colder Than Deep Space
hook: NASA cooled atoms to 0.0000000001 kelvin, below the natural temperatures listed.
closing: Extreme cold is also an engineering achievement; a laboratory can reach temperatures below the natural examples compared here.
question: What would you use ultracold atoms to study?

segments.say: Deep space's background temperature is 2.7 kelvin in this comparison. Empty space is cold, but it is not absolute zero.
NASA's Cold Atom Lab reaches 0.0000000001 kelvin in the supplied data. Its atoms are colder than the compared nebula.
The space-station laboratory orbits about 250 miles up. This extreme-cold experiment is nearby in space, rather than in a distant nebula.
